relations.text: 2025年は最大の顧客で、連結営業収益の10.8%を占めた
relations.text_en: BlackRock was the largest client organization in 2025, accounting for 10.8% of consolidated operating revenues

source.label: MSCI 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, our largest client organization by revenue, BlackRock, accounted for 10.8% of our consolidated operating revenues, with 96.5% of the operating revenues from BlackRock coming from fees based on the assets in BlackRock’s ETFs and non-ETF products that are based on our indexes .

relations.text: GICS Directの業界分類を、S&Pダウ・ジョーンズ・インデックスと共同で開発・維持している
relations.text_en: MSCI jointly develops and maintains the GICS classification with S&P Dow Jones Indices, a division of S&P Global

source.label: MSCI 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Our Index segment also includes revenues from licenses of GICS Direct , the global industry classification standard jointly developed and maintained by MSCI and S&P Dow Jones Indices, a division of S&P Global Inc.

relations.text: 指数事業の競合にS&Pダウ・ジョーンズ・インデックスがある
relations.text_en: S&P Dow Jones Indices is an index competitor

source.label: MSCI 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Among our Index competitors are S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC (a joint venture of S&P Global Inc. and CME Group Inc.);

relations.text: 分析事業の競合にファクトセットがある
relations.text_en: FactSet is a competitor in analytics

source.label: MSCI 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Our Analytics offerings compete with those from a range of competitors, including Axioma (part of SimCorp), BlackRock Solutions, Bloomberg, and FactSet Research Systems Inc.

relations.text: サステナビリティ分野の競合にサステイナリティクス(モーニングスター傘下)がある
relations.text_en: Sustainalytics, part of Morningstar, competes in sustainability and climate offerings

source.label: MSCI 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Our Sustainability and Climate offerings compete with a range of companies that issue sustainability and climate data, ratings or research, including Sustainalytics Holding B.V. (a part of Morningstar, Inc.), Institutional Shareholder Services Inc. (majority owned by Deutsche Börse AG), S&P Global Inc., Refinitiv (a London Stock Exchange Group business) and Bloomberg.

relations.text: 指数事業の競合にブルームバーグがある

source.label: MSCI 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Bloomberg Finance L.P. (“Bloomberg”); and Solactive AG.
